name: flashmarket-mobile
description: KoraMarketplace / FlashMarket web, Android e iOS com Capacitor.

scripts.mobile:android: npm run cap:add:android && npm run mobile:configure && npm run mobile:assets && npm run cap:sync
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run cap:add:ios && npm run mobile:configure && npm run mobile:assets && npm run cap:sync
scripts.mobile:prepare:all: npm run mobile:configure && npm run mobile:assets && npm run cap:sync
scripts.web:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('FlashMarket/index.html')) process.exit(1); console.log('FlashMarket web OK')"
